name: Model 2
description: Model 2's data as notional relational tables.

enforcement_levels.label: checked when loaded
enforcement_levels.description: Checked whenever the data are loaded.

enforcement_levels.label: produced together in one run
enforcement_levels.description: Both sides are produced by the same step, so they agree by construction.

enforcement_levels.label: check exists, only tests run it
enforcement_levels.description: A check exists, but only the test suite runs it; production never does.

enforcement_levels.label: resolved at run time; misses skipped
enforcement_levels.description: Resolved when the data are used; rows that miss are counted and skipped.

enforcement_levels.label: not checked (by name or order)
enforcement_levels.description: Nothing checks it; the join is by name, by order, or not at all.

enforcement_levels.label: implied by columns, not listed
enforcement_levels.description: Implied by the columns; the description does not list it as a join.

families.name: Entity registry
families.description: What exists and who owns what, on any date. Facts are never overwritten: a change adds a new version and closes the old one.
families.note: Every table here also has six history columns: valid_from and valid_to (when the fact was true; valid_to excluded), recorded_at and superseded_at (when it was learned and replaced), source and decided_by.

families.name: Observations
families.description: Every published reading, one row per value, plus the catalog of reading types and the census counts.

families.name: Sector input bundle
families.description: Each sector's drivers and statistics as ensemble draws, delivered by an outside source once per run date and never changed afterwards.
families.note: Each delivery carries a manifest listing its tables with their schema versions, row counts and checksums.

families.name: Configuration and fits
families.description: The settings that steer the model, and the parameters estimated for each sector and quarter.

families.name: Synthetic truth and scores
families.description: The known true values of a synthetic world, and the backtest scores against them.

families.name: Run outputs
families.description: What each run produces for its run date. Tables marked published are delivered to users; the rest are kept for diagnosis.

tables.name: companies
tables.description: Legal entities: operating and holding companies, subsidiaries, joint ventures, governments.
tables.unclear: Registry checks are not run: a set of consistency checks exists, but only the test suite runs them. A listed key identifies a fact, not a version; a version is the key plus its valid and recorded times.

columns.name: kind
columns.description: operating_company, holding_company, subsidiary, joint_venture, government, other

tables.name: ownership
tables.description: Company owns company.
tables.constraints: Shares of one owned company sum to at most 1 on every date. The ownership graph must have no cycles on any date.
tables.unclear: Registry checks are not run: a set of consistency checks exists, but only the test suite runs them. A listed key identifies a fact, not a version; a version is the key plus its valid and recorded times.

columns.name: controls
columns.description: whether the owner consolidates the owned company

tables.name: company_entities
tables.description: Company owns or operates entity.
tables.constraints: Owning shares of one entity sum to at most 1 on every date. A pure operator holds no share.
tables.unclear: Registry checks are not run: a set of consistency checks exists, but only the test suite runs them. A listed key identifies a fact, not a version; a version is the key plus its valid and recorded times.

tables.name: groupings
tables.description: Groupings whose membership is entered by hand: business segments and custom groupings.
tables.constraints: Only segments and custom groupings are listed here. Company, site, sector, census cell and region groupings follow on each date from the other tables.
tables.unclear: Grouping ids have two spellings: kind:id here, but two columns (subject_kind, subject_id) in observations.

tables.name: entities
tables.description: The units Model 2 models.
tables.constraints: Tracked entities need a sector, a market that fits the sector's template, and at least one site.
tables.unclear: Registry checks are not run: a set of consistency checks exists, but only the test suite runs them. A listed key identifies a fact, not a version; a version is the key plus its valid and recorded times.

columns.name: market
columns.description: required for tracked; must fit the sector's template

columns.name: region
columns.description: northeast, midwest, south, west; else from the primary site's state

tables.name: grouping_members
tables.description: Entered membership of segments and custom groupings.
tables.constraints: grouping_id may also name a company grouping, to override its derived weights. Weight 0 removes the entity.
tables.unclear: Registry checks are not run: a set of consistency checks exists, but only the test suite runs them. A listed key identifies a fact, not a version; a version is the key plus its valid and recorded times.

columns.name: grouping_id
columns.description: or a company grouping, to override derived weights

tables.name: entity_sites
tables.description: Which entity operates at which site.
tables.constraints: Every tracked entity must have at least one site.
tables.unclear: Registry checks are not run: a set of consistency checks exists, but only the test suite runs them. A listed key identifies a fact, not a version; a version is the key plus its valid and recorded times.

columns.name: capacity_share
columns.description: share of the entity's capacity at this site

tables.name: identifiers
tables.description: Outside ids (SEC CIK, LEI, EPA facility id and so on).
tables.unclear: Registry checks are not run: a set of consistency checks exists, but only the test suite runs them. A listed key identifies a fact, not a version; a version is the key plus its valid and recorded times.

tables.name: sites
tables.description: Physical locations.
tables.unclear: Registry checks are not run: a set of consistency checks exists, but only the test suite runs them. A listed key identifies a fact, not a version; a version is the key plus its valid and recorded times.

columns.name: site_type
columns.description: plant, airport, campus, warehouse, mine, terminal, port, office, other

tables.name: match_decisions
tables.description: How a name found in a source (a mention) was matched to a registry object.
tables.constraints: Automatic above score 0.95; human review from 0.5 to 0.95.
tables.unclear: Registry checks are not run: a set of consistency checks exists, but only the test suite runs them. A listed key identifies a fact, not a version; a version is the key plus its valid and recorded times.

columns.name: matched_object_type
columns.description: empty when unmatched or in review

columns.name: outcome
columns.description: exact_identifier, auto_match, new_object, unmatched, review, reviewed

tables.name: observations
tables.description: Every published reading, one row per value, from any number of sources.
tables.constraints: Subject resolved in order: (subject_kind, subject_id); else the outside id through identifiers on the period's last day; else the mention through match_decisions. Rows that resolve to nothing are counted and skipped. A run as of T uses only rows with published ≤ T.
tables.unclear: No declared schema: types, codes and the key are not checked, so obs_id may repeat. 21% of synthetic rows name their subject only by an outside id or a mention.

columns.name: source
columns.description: e.g. sec_10q; kept, not used by the model

columns.name: subject_id
columns.description: the entity id or the grouping's id

columns.name: mention_id
columns.description: used when both of the above are empty

columns.name: period_start, period_end
columns.description: one month, or three for a quarter

columns.name: value
columns.description: in the type's unit, before any transform

columns.name: published
columns.description: a run as of T uses rows with published ≤ T

columns.name: confidence
columns.description: kept, not used by the model

tables.name: observation_types
tables.description: The catalog of the 29 kinds of reading Model 2 can predict.
tables.constraints: Each run keeps a copy.

columns.name: subjects
columns.description: subject kinds the type may name

columns.name: members
columns.description: all, only tracked or only representative

columns.name: requires
columns.description: the equation module the template must have

columns.name: definition, formula
columns.description: what it means and how it is predicted

tables.name: census_counts
tables.description: County Business Patterns counts that size the representative entities.
tables.constraints: A row's (sector, size_class, region) is one census cell, the same triple as entities.group_id.

tables.name: manifest
tables.description: One row per delivery: who produced it, for which date, and what it contains.
tables.constraints: A delivery is complete only when it carries checksums for every table and a completion mark.

columns.name: producer, consumer
columns.description: who made it and for whom

columns.name: producer_version
columns.description: which version of the producer made it

columns.name: tables
columns.description: name, schema, schema_version, rows, checksum for each

tables.name: receipts
tables.description: Model 2's verdict on each bundle it has checked.
tables.constraints: A run uses the latest accepted bundle as of its date, unless the configuration pins another or lists it as known bad.

tables.name: sectors
tables.description: The sector list.
tables.constraints: The template set here decides which equations a sector uses; the configuration can only override individual modules.
tables.unclear: No master list of sectors: this table is the only one and it changes with every bundle. Registry, configuration, census counts and truth carry sector codes that nothing checks against one list.

columns.name: has_driver_block
columns.description: whether the bundle carries drivers for this sector

columns.name: template
columns.description: one of six templates, or pass_through for the economy-wide row

tables.name: series_catalog
tables.description: What each series is.

columns.name: name
columns.description: demand, input_cost, price for drivers; e.g. CAPUTLG211S

columns.name: unit
columns.description: a dollar demand driver is deflated by the price driver

tables.name: drivers
tables.description: The three monthly drivers per sector, every draw.
tables.constraints: Every month from history_start to forecast_end with no gaps; every member present.
tables.unclear: Status vocabulary differs: drivers use smoothed/nowcast/forecast, sector series observed/nowcast/forecast.

tables.name: sector_series
tables.description: Sector statistics and their nowcasts, every draw.
tables.constraints: An observed value must be the same in every draw.
tables.unclear: Status vocabulary differs: drivers use smoothed/nowcast/forecast, sector series observed/nowcast/forecast.

columns.name: status
columns.description: observed, nowcast, forecast; observed equal in every draw

tables.name: series_summary
tables.description: Mean, sd and quantiles of each driver and series by month.
tables.constraints: Part of every delivery, but not used by Model 2.

tables.name: input_diagnostics
tables.description: Metric and value pairs from the producer.
tables.constraints: Model 2 uses one: converged must be true.

tables.name: run_settings
tables.description: Members, forecast horizon, seed, order-share and congestion switches.

columns.name: setting
columns.description: members, forecast horizon, seed, order-share and congestion switches

tables.name: estimation_settings
tables.description: Rounds, L-BFGS and sector steps, batch size, Monte Carlo sets, which sectors use the representative scale step.

columns.name: setting
columns.description: rounds, L-BFGS and sector steps, batch size, Monte Carlo sets

tables.name: observation_settings
tables.description: Noise sd per type, sensor calibrations (a, b), match threshold and inflation.

tables.name: sector_settings
tables.description: Required drivers, capacity per establishment by size class, transit months, default starting cost.

tables.name: series_mappings
tables.description: The sector quantity each input series measures, its unit transform, noise floor and inflation.

tables.name: sector_priors
tables.description: Prior mean and sd per sector parameter, with a required reason.

tables.name: fit_runs
tables.description: One estimation of one sector for one quarter: its date, the input delivery used, normalising constants, how the fit converged.
tables.constraints: A run reuses the fit for its quarter if one exists.
tables.unclear: A fit is reused for every run in its quarter without checking whether the input delivery or the settings have changed since.

columns.name: entity, group and sector lists
columns.description: the order the parameter tables follow

tables.name: sector_params
tables.description: Sector-shared parameters ψ̂ (27) and covariance; sector means μ_s, spread Σ_s, pooling strengths κ.
tables.unclear: These parameters carry no entity, group or parameter names; they line up with fit_runs only by order.

columns.name: parameter
columns.description: position in the fixed parameter order

tables.name: entity_params
tables.description: θ̂ (23 per entity, on transformed scales) and its Laplace covariance V.
tables.unclear: These parameters carry no entity or parameter names; each row lines up with fit_runs' entity list by order, each column with a fixed parameter order.

columns.name: parameter
columns.description: position in the fixed parameter order

tables.name: group_params
tables.description: Group means μ_g.
tables.unclear: These parameters carry no entity, group or parameter names; they line up with fit_runs only by order.

columns.name: parameter
columns.description: position in the fixed parameter order

tables.name: representative_scale
tables.description: Variance of the starting level; the 2×2 covariance of scale and labor per unit.
tables.unclear: These parameters carry no entity, group or parameter names; they line up with fit_runs only by order.

tables.name: truth_sector_totals
tables.description: True sector totals.

tables.name: truth_sector_components
tables.description: True tracked and representative parts.

tables.name: truth_entity_states
tables.description: True entity states.
tables.unclear: variable is the model's internal symbol (k, z, Bs …), not the output name (capacity, utilization, backlog).

tables.name: truth_entity_params
tables.description: True entity parameters.

columns.name: param
columns.description: in the model's fixed parameter order

tables.name: truth_sector_params
tables.description: True sector parameters.

tables.name: truth_drivers
tables.description: The true demand, price and input-cost change.

tables.name: truth_normalization
tables.description: The constants used to centre demand and capacity.

tables.name: backtest_scores
tables.description: One row per scored value.
tables.unclear: Backtest records are kept in two places, linked only by the run's name as text.

tables.name: backtest_source
tables.description: Which model version ran, when it started, which run dates, which estimation settings.

tables.name: accuracy_checkpoints
tables.description: One summary per scored backtest: time, label, model version, run, mean error, coverage, error by sector.
tables.unclear: Backtest records are kept in two places, linked only by the run's name as text.

tables.name: sector_aggregates
tables.description: The main product: every sector quantity, month and draw.
tables.constraints: One run date has about 5.8 million rows.
tables.unclear: Holds every draw; medians and 90% bands are not included, so every user computes them.

columns.name: variable

columns.name: value

tables.description: Which input draw each output draw used.

tables.name: variables
tables.description: What each sector quantity means.
tables.constraints: Only the quantities a sector's template produces are listed.

tables.name: coverage
tables.description: How much of each sector the tracked entities cover.

tables.name: reconciliation
tables.description: Where sector totals and the input sector series disagree.
tables.constraints: All values in the series' own units.

tables.name: identifiability
tables.description: How far the data moved each sector quantity from its prior.

tables.name: run_diagnostics
tables.description: Ensemble spread, observation counts, timings.

tables.name: run_config
tables.description: The configuration as the run used it.

tables.description: A snapshot of the registry's entities at the run date.
tables.constraints: Off by default.

tables.name: entity_states
tables.description: Every entity's quantities by month and draw.

tables.name: grouping_spans
tables.description: Every grouping's members, with weights and the dates of each span.
tables.unclear: The only record of the derived groupings; between runs there is nothing to join against.

tables.name: observation_fit
